speaker: A
name: Alex
text: My father is a worker — the kind of guy who builds and renovates houses — and his car was always full of tools.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: So whenever I rode in his car, I had to put up with that smell for the whole ride, and it made me dizzy.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: So no, I didn't enjoy traveling by car as a kid.
